generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A transformation can accidentally treat its own outputs as new inputs, while an evidence manifest can similarly self-declare an incomplete vocabulary and appear internally consistent.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Apply sequential replacement over an overlapping character domain, or accept a risk manifest without validating it against an external canonical schema.
trigger_signals: replacement output overlaps replacement input domain
evidence manifest defines its own family vocabulary
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Use a mixed-validity sibling test for transformation domains and an external canonical-schema validator for evidence manifests before certification.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Make repair mappings single-pass or guard each input atom against an unambiguous malformed-domain predicate; generate evidence vocabulary from the canonical contract rather than local custom labels.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Test mixed strings containing valid output-domain values plus malformed inputs, and fail handoff when canonical risk families, applicability reasons, surfaces, or control bindings are missing.

transfer_cases.case: A mixed string retains valid accented characters while only malformed markers are transformed.
A manifest omitting canonical families is rejected by an external schema validator.

skill_changes.evidence: Delivery prevention now requires one-pass/unambiguous-domain repair and canonical risk-family generation before certification.
Delivery detection now includes mixed-validity migration regression coverage and canonical risk-saturation validation.
